<thought>Applying the nitro‑to‑amine reduction retrosynthetic template to the target molecule yields a single precursor where the aromatic amine is replaced by a nitro group. The precursor SMILES is "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F". Therefore the answer is a list containing one inner list with this SMILES.</thought>
